name: What should I do before cabinet installation starts so the job doesn’t get delayed?

mainEntity.name: What should I do before cabinet installation starts so the job doesn’t get delayed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way to avoid delays is to clear the kitchen, confirm your cabinet layout, and make sure the installer has accurate measurements before start day. A good installer should also tell you whether any wall repairs, plumbing, or electrical changes need to happen first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the kitchen, verify measurements, and confirm whether any plumbing, electrical, or wall work must happen first. That prep reduces surprises and keeps the install moving.
